messages.subject: Error in part 5
parts:

I'm new to GGIR and the only one at my university using GGIR and am hoping for some help. I ran this code about a month ago to make sure it'd work on accelerometer data I am collecting and it worked fine. Now I'm getting an error saying: Error in as.character(Value) :
cannot coerce type 'closure' to vector of type 'character': 

I've tried to run it on a few different .gt3x files and get the same error. I'm a bit stuck so any help/advice would be helpful. I've provided an image of the error, as well as my code. Thanks in advance for your help. 


My code is: 

library(GGIR)
GGIR(mode=c(1:5),
     datadir="C:/Users/al122872/Study/Data",
     outputdir="C:/Users/al122872/Study/Results",
     # Part 1 parameters:
     #-------------------------------
     windowsizes = c(5,900,3600),
     do.cal=TRUE,
     do.enmo = TRUE,

     chunksize=1,

     # Part 2:

     strategy = 2,        #strategy      
     ndayswindow=7, #only relevant when strategy is 3
     hrs.del.start = 0, #only relevant when strategy is 2. How many hours need to be ignored at the start of measurement

     maxdur = 9,  #how many DAYS of measurement to you maximally expect                
     includedaycrit = 16, #number of minimum valid hours in a day to attempt PA analysis
     winhr = c(5,10), #size of M5 and L5
     qlevels = c(), #quantiles to calculate, set value at C() if you do not want quantiles
     qwindow=c(0,24), #window over which to calculate quantiles
     ilevels = c(0,100,400,8000), #acceleration values (metric ENMO) from  which a frequency distribution need to be
     iglevels = TRUE,
     mvpathreshold =c(100,120), #MVPA threshold
     bout.metric = 4,
     closedbout=FALSE,
     #-------------------------------
     # Part 3:
     #-------------------------------
     # Key functions: Sleep detection
     anglethreshold=5,
     timethreshold= c(5),      #minimum duration in mins, 5 default and current evidence best choice    
     ignorenonwear = TRUE,
     do.part3.pdf = TRUE,
     #-------------------------------
     # Part 4:
     #-------------------------------
     # Key functions: Integrating sleep log (if available) with sleep detection
     # storing day and person specific summaries of sleep
     excludefirstlast = FALSE, #exclude first and last night for sleep analysis?
     includenightcrit = 16, #number of minimum valid hours in a day to attempt slleep analysis
     def.noc.sleep = c(1), #C()
     #if sleep log is available
     #loglocation= , #file location if applicable, otherwise leave blank
     outliers.only = FALSE,
     criterror = 4,
     relyonsleeplog = FALSE,
     sleeplogidnum = TRUE,
     colid=1,
     coln1=2,
     do.visual = TRUE,
     nnights = 9,
     #=====================
     # Part 5:
     # Key functions: Merging physical activity with sleep analyses
     #-------------------------------
     excludefirstlast.part5 = FALSE,
     save_ms5rawlevels= FALSE,
     threshold.lig = c(30), #threshold(s) for inactivity, can be more than 1 number
     threshold.mod = c(100),  #threshold(s) for moderate activity
     threshold.vig = c(400), #threshold(s) for vigorous activity
     boutcriter = 0.8,      
     boutcriter.in = 0.9,     #fraction of an inactivity that needs to be below the threshold
     boutcriter.lig = 0.8,  #fraction of an light activity that needs to be below the threshold
     boutcriter.mvpa = 0.8, #fraction of an mvpa activity that needs to be below the threshold
     boutdur.in = c(1,10,30), #duration of bouts to be calculated
     boutdur.lig = c(1,10), #duration of bouts to be calculated
     boutdur.mvpa = c(1),   #duration of bouts to be calculated
     #=====================
     # Report generation
     #-------------------------------
     # Key functions: Generating reports based on meta-data
     do.report=c(2:5),
     visualreport=TRUE,    
     dofirstpage = TRUE, #first page of pdf report with simple summary histograms
     viewingwindow=1) #viewing window of visual report: 1 centres at day, 2 centres at night
